authority: Environment Agency / Defra Data Services Platform
checks: point cloud contains three-dimensional x y z points
point cloud includes component attributes beyond elevation
site-specific DTM and DSM gridded products are derived from point-cloud surveys
point-cloud attributes can support bespoke raster products such as canopy-height or intensity rasters
site-specific LIDAR surveys extend back to 1998
historic DTM or DSM tiles may lack a matching archived point cloud
processing classifies returns into ground and surface-object classes
coverage metadata is available separately from the point-cloud payload
point-cloud lineage must not be assumed to be one-to-one with every historic raster tile
